svg.title: Figure 2-1. Hazardous-event rows per S x E x C cell (WP-C-03 §2.1)
svg.desc: Two ISO 26262-3 Table 4 matrices (severity S1-S3 by exposure E1-E4 rows, controllability C1-C3 columns), coloured by ASIL, give the number of hazardous-event rows of the reference-scope Cartesian HARA in each cell. As rated: QM 871, A 716, B 607, C 62, D 0. If every AoU-credited controllability rating is raised by one class: QM 629, A 596, B 809, C 193, D 29. 1008 rows rated S0 are not shown.
svg.text: Figure 2-1 · Hazardous-event rows per S × E × C cell
Cartesian HARA, reference scope (Chill only): 3264 rows = 32 SC pairs × 17 situations × 6 conditions
C as rated; ⚠ ratings credit unverified AoUs (AOU-01/02/03/05/10)
C+1 on every row whose C rating credits an unverified AoU
Not shown: 1008 rows rated S0 (malfunction not hazardous in that situation; the reason is recorded per row in hara-events.csv). No row is rated E0 or C0.
Each number counts rows (function × guide word × situation × condition). The same (function, guide word, situation) appears up to six times, once per weather/surface condition.
Cell colour = ASIL of the cell (Table 4) · number = rows in the cell · – = none
